items.title: All 5 players from Golden State’s most-used starting lineup last season will be missing tomorrow’s game against the Clippers: Stephen Curry, Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler, and Moses Moody are all OUT, and Quinten Post is no longer on the team.
items.author: Justin Russo
items.body_excerpt: All 5 players from Golden State’s most-used starting lineup last season will be missing tomorrow’s game against the Clippers: Stephen Curry, Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler, and Moses Moody are all OUT, and Quinten Post is no longer on the team.
